description: Header file defining the implementation class 'e1ap_cu_cp_impl' for E1AP control plane in a 5G core network, including method declarations, class members, and internal handlers related to E1AP messaging, UE context, and bearer management.

classes.name: e1ap_cu_cp_impl
classes.description: Final class implementing the e1ap_cu_cp interface, managing E1AP control plane operations, message handling, UE context, and bearer management with internal logging and notifier mechanisms.

classes.name: e1ap_message_notifier_with_logging
classes.description: Decorator class for e1ap_message_notifier that adds logging functionality for transmitted E1AP messages.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Asynchronous task to stop the E1AP control plane implementation.

methods.name: handle_cu_cp_e1_reset_message
methods.description: Handles E1 reset messages received from the CU-CP.

methods.name: handle_cu_up_e1_setup_response
methods.description: Processes E1 setup responses from CU-UP.

methods.name: handle_message
methods.description: Main message handler for incoming E1AP messages.

methods.name: cancel_ue_tasks
methods.description: Cancels all tasks related to a specific UE.

methods.name: remove_bearer_context
methods.description: Removes bearer context for a UE.

methods.name: get_nof_ues
methods.description: Returns the number of UEs currently managed.

methods.name: log_pdu
methods.description: Logs transmitted or received E1AP PDUs.
